title: A bifurcation of transverse intersections
promptMarkdown: For $f_a(t)=(t,t^3-t+a)$ and $Z=\mathbb R\times\{0\}$, determine all parameters for which $f_a\pitchfork Z$ and count the intersections for each parameter range. Verify that $F(a,t)=f_a(t)$ is a submersion and reconcile the exceptional parameters with Sard.
hintLadder: A horizontal target tangent misses only the vertical derivative component.
Solve the derivative-zero and height-zero equations together.
Use the two turning values of the cubic.
